integrity: Analytic proof for all positive dimensionless steps at sizes 3–5 and for all sizes 6 or more at sufficiently large steps; finite exact symbolic checks supplement, not replace, the proof. Historical literature comparison remains qualified; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform, symmetric, nearest-neighbor periodic 1D heat stencil; one-step two-stage Gauss-Legendre endpoint in exact arithmetic only. The Green-function asymptotic remainder is fixed-size, not uniform in node number. No claim about internal stages or nonuniform/Dirichlet grids.
title: Five periodic nodes are the sharp unconditional-positivity frontier for Gauss–Legendre heat stepping
